reviews.review_description: The screen shots are false and do not represent the actual graphics the graphics look ps1 one blocky and terrible ti would be willing to accept the early access bugs and glitches but to lie about the graphics quality with the screenshots trust me this is a sloppy cash grab not worth buying and also tried to refund it got turned down there is zero mission no trailers waste of money take my advice dont buy this trash unless you enjoy wasting your money and getting motion sickness
